sessions.phase_label: Multi-location planning, design, implementation, review, and site-association correction

requirements.title: Master-Site Location Discovery and Routing
requirements.definition: The Shatter House USA master site must let visitors select a location and route them to the corresponding location website.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers location selection and routing only; informational homepage sections, location booking behavior, and backend isolation are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Future Location Expansion
requirements.definition: The site architecture must allow future franchise locations to be added without redesigning the overall system.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers extensibility and reusable location structure, not the current Ridgehaven coming-soon content or the master location selector.

requirements.title: Correct Site Content-to-Profile Mapping
requirements.definition: Master-site and location-site content must be associated with the correct Wix profiles and accounts rather than being reversed.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers which profile/account owns each site's content and settings; public domain attachment is a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Correct Domain-to-Website Mapping
requirements.definition: Each public domain, including the Shatter House USA domain, must connect to the intended website.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers public domain attachment and routing only; it does not imply that account-bound subscriptions, settings, or content profiles have also been transferred.

requirements.title: Location Staff Access Isolation
requirements.definition: Each location must have independently controlled staff access to its operational website and backend.
requirements.boundary_note: Staff authorization can be configured or fail independently of payments, bookings, and customer data, so it remains a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Competitor-Inspired Visual Layout and Navigation
requirements.definition: The sites must use a clean, simple visual structure and navigation based on the supplied competitor website rather than the preliminary mockup.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers layout, structure, and navigation reference; company logos, colors, content identity, and mobile responsiveness are separate constraints.

requirements.title: Responsive Mobile-Friendly Design
requirements.definition: The national brand website and its location experiences must be usable and visually appropriate on mobile devices.
requirements.boundary_note: Responsiveness is independently testable across device sizes and is not merely an attribute of the competitor-inspired visual style.

requirements.title: Shatter House Brand Identity
requirements.definition: Both the master and location sites must use the Shatter House identity, approved logos, colors, and brand content consistently.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers brand identity and assets rather than page layout; incorrect temporary branding can fail while the structural design remains acceptable.

requirements.title: Master Homepage Information Sections
requirements.definition: The master homepage must present the requested informational sections for activities, events, reviews, FAQ, and contact information.
requirements.boundary_note: The requested section inventory is one homepage content structure; the functional location selector is owned by the master location-directory Requirement.

requirements.title: Activity-Specific Image Accuracy
requirements.definition: Axe-throwing content must use axe-throwing imagery, while splatter-room content must show paint-participation imagery.
requirements.boundary_note: The two image rules are attributes of one activity-media accuracy mechanism rather than separate Requirements for each image category.

requirements.title: Consistent Packages and Pricing
requirements.definition: Location websites must include the required packages and preserve the shared package and pricing structure across locations.
requirements.boundary_note: Package and price content can be missing or changed independently of booking-software availability, so it is not merged with booking behavior.

requirements.title: Ridgehaven Coming-Soon Page
requirements.definition: Ridgehaven must initially have a promotional coming-soon page with its specified sections and opening-state controls, structured for later activation without redesign.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the temporary launch-state page and its transition readiness; VIP email capture and general location-booking operation are separate behaviors.

requirements.title: Ridgehaven VIP Email Signup
requirements.definition: The Ridgehaven page must provide a functional VIP email-signup action for prospective customers before opening.
requirements.boundary_note: Email capture has its own input, storage, and success behavior and can be implemented or tested independently of the surrounding coming-soon page.

requirements.title: Legacy Content and Image Reuse
requirements.definition: Relevant content, images, and booking information from the existing Harbor Valley site must be reused as source material for the new sites.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers migration of source assets and content, not visual-style reuse; the final design is still required to be new and competitor-inspired.

requirements.title: SEO Preservation During Rebrand and Migration
requirements.definition: The rebrand and website migration must minimize damage to Harbor Valley search rankings by preserving important SEO elements and handling the transition carefully.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers search-ranking continuity and migration practices; whether the legacy site remains publicly live is a separate operational transition constraint.

requirements.title: Legacy Site Availability During Transition
requirements.definition: The existing Harbor Valley site must remain live during the transition and be linkable from the new master website where appropriate.
requirements.boundary_note: Public availability and linking can change independently of SEO metadata preservation, so the transition-availability rule remains separate.

requirements.title: Preimplementation Site Mockup
requirements.definition: A reviewable mockup of the second website must be supplied before full implementation proceeds.
requirements.boundary_note: This is retained because the mockup is an independently requested design artifact, not merely generic testing or project-status activity.

source_message.text:
Hey! I wanted to send over the vision for the website.

The goal is to build a national brand website for SHATTER HOUSE that can support multiple locations and future franchise growth.

Main Website:
https://shatterhouseusa.example

For the visual direction, use a clean, modern, mobile-friendly design with simplicity similar to RageWorks USA. The branding should combine black, purple, and white with large images, generous spacing, and easy navigation.

Homepage Sections:

Hero Banner
Location Selector
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
Reviews
FAQ
Contact

The homepage should immediately show visitors what we offer and allow them to select their location.

Current Locations:

Linden Falls
Port Averly
Ridgehaven

Give every location its own dedicated page while keeping the design and branding consistent across all locations. The website should be built so future locations can be added easily without redesigning the site.

Future examples:

Mesa Crest
Highpoint
Riverbend
Franchise Locations

The overall feel should be a national entertainment brand, not a local business website.
